prompt: Before heading to the train station, Elena left a quick note for her neighbour. In it, she (say / tell) him to shake the green treat jar twice if the ginger cat hides behind the sofa.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell используется прямое дополнение (him) и инфинитив с частицей to (tell someone to do something). Глагол say в такой конструкции не употребляется.

prompt: In an official update posted online, the lead bridge engineer (say / tell) commuters that the pedestrian walkway will remain open all week while crews finish painting the blue railings.
explanation_ru: Здесь после глагола сразу идет адресат сообщения (commuters) без предлога to, поэтому требуется форма глагола tell (tell someone that...).

prompt: Under the carrot cake recipe, Yael left a helpful comment sharing what her aunt, a professional baker, once (say / tell) her: grating the carrots finely and resting the batter for ten minutes makes the sponge much softer.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «what someone told her» требует глагола tell, так как сразу за ним следует косвенное дополнение (her) без предлога.

prompt: The municipal lost-and-found notice outlines the steps for claiming wallets or keys found in city parks; it (say / tell) that owners must describe one unique detail inside the item before pickup.
explanation_ru: В письменных объявлениях и правилах для передачи содержания текста без указания адресата используется глагол say в конструкции say that...

prompt: Quoting the mission director after the launch, the science report (say / tell) that the compact weather satellite deployed its silver solar panels smoothly on its very first orbit.
explanation_ru: После глагола сразу следует придаточное предложение с союзом that без указания слушателя, поэтому правильный вариант — say (said / says).

prompt: Before leaving for the weekend, Sara left a neat note on the fridge that (say / tell) how to water the balcony ferns and double-lock the back porch door.
explanation_ru: О содержимом записки, таблички или письма говорят с помощью глагола say (a note says / said), а не tell.

prompt: After last night's run-through, the lighting operator (say / tell) us that the shiny silver tray reflects the spotlight straight into the front row's eyes.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат без предлога to (told us that...), тогда как после say нужно to us.

prompt: At the till, the bakery owner proudly (say / tell) that every loaf of sourdough is baked fresh at five in the morning using local oats.
explanation_ru: Когда адресат речи не указан (сразу идёт придаточное с that), используется глагол say, а не tell.

prompt: Good news everyone: I just checked with the café owner, and she (say / tell) me we can bring our own homemade cake as long as nobody lights sparklers indoors.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу ставится прямое дополнение — адресат (told me), без предлога to.

prompt: Quick update from the clinic: the nurse (say / tell) Dad to bring his updated glasses and insurance card to next week's eye test.
explanation_ru: Для передачи просьбы или инструкции используется конструкция tell + кто + to + инфинитив (told Dad to bring); глагол say так не употребляется.

prompt: Local builders uncovered several curved stones while repairing the old harbour wall on Tuesday. A museum specialist inspected the site and (say / tell) reporters that the blocks belonged to a forgotten eighteenth-century lighthouse. Her full report (say / tell) that further digging will pause until Friday.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске указан адресат без предлога (told reporters), поэтому нужен tell. Во втором пропуске передаётся содержание отчёта без адресата, поэтому используется say (says / said that).

prompt: Before we booked the countryside cabin, the host (say / tell) us that the area was completely silent at night. Honestly, I felt he did not (say / tell) the whole truth about the neighbourhood. He never once (say / tell) anything about the loud rooster living right behind our fence.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после глагола сразу идёт адресат (told us). Во втором используется устойчивое выражение tell the truth («говорить правду»). В третьем после глагола стоит дополнение anything без адресата (said anything).

prompt: Hi Mark, I just finished my job interview and wanted to let you know what happened. During the meeting, the panel (speak / talk) to me about my previous warehouse role for nearly twenty minutes. They also (say / tell) that they might call you tomorrow to confirm my shift schedule.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске с предлогом to и темой беседы about подходят оба глагола — speak и talk (spoke / talked to me about). Во втором пропуске адресат не указан (сразу идёт придаточное с that), поэтому нужен глагол said.

prompt: Our kids loved the natural history museum, especially the giant skeleton near the main entrance. A friendly hall guard (say / tell) them not to worry about the sharp teeth. He proudly (say / tell) that the huge skull is actually a lightweight model so children can look closely.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется конструкция tell + адресат + not to + инфинитив (told them not to worry). Во втором адресат не назван, сразу идёт придаточное с that, поэтому требуется said.

prompt: The band arrived twenty minutes late for their set, yet the crowd stayed in high spirits. Between songs, the lead singer (speak / talk) to the audience about their chaotic trip down the motorway. He (say / tell) everyone that their van had broken down twice, forcing the drummer to hitchhike with two cymbals.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске при обращении к аудитории (to the audience about...) уместны оба глагола — spoke или talked. Во втором пропуске сразу указан адресат без предлога (told everyone), поэтому нужен глагол tell.

prompt: I just spoke to the coach company about Friday's museum trip. They (confirm) that the bus leaves promptly at 8:30. Please (inform) your parents to drop you off by the bike shed at 8:15, and let's (discuss) the gallery map tomorrow morning.
explanation_ru: После say (that) не ставится прямое дополнение-лицо; после tell обязательно нужно дополнение (tell your parents); глагол talk требует предлога about перед темой обсуждения.

prompt: After painting tiny dots on local bumblebees, the lead biologist ___ the insects remembered which garden flowers refilled fastest every morning.
explanation_ru: Для передачи содержания высказывания без указания адресата используется конструкция say (that).

prompt: Before Vera bought the cordless kettle, the shop clerk ___ use the temperature buttons safely and clean the metal filter.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell употребляется с прямым дополнением-лицом и вопросительным словом с инфинитивом: tell someone how to do something.

prompt: After the race, the winning crew captain ___ shifting wind near the last buoy almost spun their boat sideways fifty metres from the finish.
explanation_ru: Когда сразу за глаголом идет придаточное предложение без адресата, используется say (said [that]...).

prompt: In the last update notes, the developers ___ users there would be fewer pop-ups, yet three giant ads now cover tomorrow's forecast.
explanation_ru: Если сразу после глагола указано, кому именно адресована информация (users), используется tell.

prompt: Wearing a bright yellow vest, the marshal said drivers to fold in their wing mirrors and switch off car alarms before the ferry left.
answer: Wearing a bright yellow vest, the marshal told drivers to fold in their wing mirrors and switch off car alarms before the ferry left.
accepted_answers: Wearing a bright yellow vest, the marshal told drivers to fold in their wing mirrors and switch off car alarms before the ferry left.
explanation_ru: Для передачи приказа или инструкции используется конструкция tell + дополнение + to-инфинитив (told drivers to fold), а не say.

prompt: The desk worker circled the purple bus stop on the map and told us how to reach the shuttle without walking through the icy car park.
answer: The desk worker circled the purple bus stop on the map and told us how to reach the shuttle without walking through the icy car park.
accepted_answers: The desk worker circled the purple bus stop on the map and told us how to reach the shuttle without walking through the icy car park.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: глагол tell правильно употреблен с дополнением (us) и конструкцией how to reach.

prompt: Before the timer started, the supervisor said us where to leave smartwatches and how to save each answer.
answer: Before the timer started, the supervisor told us where to leave smartwatches and how to save each answer.
accepted_answers: Before the timer started, the supervisor told us where to leave smartwatches and how to save each answer.
explanation_ru: После глагола say нельзя ставить прямое дополнение (us) без предлога to; перед вопросительным словом и инфинитивом с указанием адресата используется tell (told us where to leave).

prompt: You are writing a short local post passing along Sunday's forecast from the coastal weather office. Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: The coastal weather office said that brisk westerly winds will bring cool, sunny skies on Sunday.
The coastal weather office told that brisk westerly winds will bring cool, sunny skies on Sunday.
The coastal weather office said us that brisk westerly winds will bring cool, sunny skies on Sunday.
The coastal weather office spoke that brisk westerly winds will bring cool, sunny skies on Sunday.
explanation_ru: Глагол say вводит придаточное с союзом that без указания слушателя; tell требует дополнения-лица.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'said' instead of 'told': Tessa told the design team that the client wanted to change the green logo to navy blue.
answer: Tessa said to the design team that the client wanted to change the green logo to navy blue.
accepted_answers: Tessa said to the design team that the client wanted to change the green logo to navy blue.
Tessa said that the client wanted to change the green logo to navy blue.
explanation_ru: В отличие от tell (told the design team), глагол say требует предлога to перед указанием адресата (said to the design team).
